remediations.problem: snapshots never expire - metadata grows without bound

actions.description: Schedule CALL catalog.system.expire_snapshots with a retention window
actions.rationale: unbounded snapshots slow planning and bloat storage
actions.validation: snapshot count and metadata size drop

prerequisites: agree retention with downstream time-travel users
risks: expiring snapshots kills time travel beyond the window
rollback_notes: snapshots cannot be un-expired; export metadata first

actions.expected_effect: file count bounded at target size
actions.validation: avg file size near target; scan time drops

risks: concurrent writes may conflict with compaction
validation_steps: check commit conflicts during first runs
rollback_notes: roll back the compaction snapshot on conflict

remediations.problem: manifests never rewritten - planning reads many manifest files

actions.validation: manifest count and planning ms drop

remediations.problem: write pattern produces small Iceberg data files

actions.description: Remove single-partition writes; repartition by partition key
Enable write.distribution-mode or Spark adaptive coalesce for the sink
actions.rationale: engine-side shuffling fixes fan-out without code churn

remediations.problem: format-version too low for the declared operations

actions.description: Set format-version=2 in the table properties
actions.rationale: MERGE/UPDATE/DELETE and row-level deletes need v2

actions.description: Verify every writer/reader engine supports v2 before flipping
actions.rationale: v1 readers cannot read v2 delete files

prerequisites: inventory all engines touching the table
risks: older engines silently misread or fail on v2 tables
rollback_notes: format-version is one-way in practice; test on a copy

remediations.problem: table feature requires a higher format-version

actions.description: Raise format-version to the level the feature requires, or drop the feature
actions.rationale: features like deletion vectors/row lineage gate on format-version
actions.expected_effect: feature works or is removed explicitly
